stepcap.def: STEP-CAP(t, a): R acc at the value slot of V_t on items whose R(V_{t-1}) decodes E_{t-1} exactly; a = non-VOID content slots of E_{t-1}; t <= n; slope over a with >= 3 t values (cells with >= 10 items)

bank_ablate.def: draft §7 / note 211-14: versions 1..t-2 masked at every pass (core, gather) and in the coda; V_0 and the newest kept; K' = n + 2

bank_off.def: every bank logit -inf (core and coda; the gather still reads all versions), K' = n + 2

stall.def: stored V_t := V_{t-1} at t = ceil(n/2); stalled acc at K' = n + 1 / intact acc at K' = n, pooled n 4..8
